India and US Hold Key Trade Talks for Interim Agreement

India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to finalize the first phase of a trade agreement. The talks focused on key aspects of an interim deal, with discussions expected to cover trade, tariffs, and securing tariff advantages for India. The meetings aim to strengthen economic cooperation between the two nations.
